invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object.
The input List<HoodieRecord<T>> is required and typically non-null for bulk insert actions.
HoodieWriteMetadata should encapsulate non-null WriteStatus results.
instantTime is a critical string value for versioning and should be initialized and non-empty.
The HoodieEngineContext must be provided for any engine operation.
